about: Expected results for POST /context/mcp/parse. Each case is a node:test case. 'servers' use the shared store's canonical shape (validateMcpServer in docker/setup/mcp/store.mjs), without 'enabled'. 'placeholders' lists fields whose values still look like placeholders. Names are suggestions the user can edit.

rules.order: Try TOML first when any line starts a [mcp_servers.<name>] table (Codex snippets start with [, like a JSON array). Then JSON when the text starts with { or [. Then a 'claude mcp add' command, then a single http(s) URL, then a command line. Text that starts with { or [ and is neither TOML nor valid JSON is a JSON error, never a command line.
rules.jsonShapes: mcpServers.<name> (Claude Code, Cursor, .mcp.json) through fromClaudeEntry / fromCursorEntry; mcp.<name> (OpenCode 1) and mcp.servers.<name> (OpenCode 2) through fromOpenCodeEntry; a bare { command, args, env } or { url, headers } object with no name.
rules.lexer: POSIX-style: single quotes literal, double quotes with backslash escapes, backslash outside quotes escapes the next character. No expansion of $VARS, globs or ~. Nothing is executed.
rules.names: Config formats: the key. Command lines: the package after npx/bunx/uvx/pnpm dlx (the first argument that isn't an option), the image after docker run (the first argument after run that is neither an option nor the value of -e, --env, -v, --volume, -p, --publish, --name, --network, -w or --workdir; then its last path segment), else the executable's base name. Then lowercase, drop @scope/, @version and :tag, drop a leading mcp-server- or server- and a trailing -mcp-server, -mcp or -server, replace anything outside [a-z0-9-] with -, collapse and trim hyphens. URLs: the first host label that isn't www, mcp or api, excluding the last label. Fallback: 'server'.
rules.placeholders: A value containing <...>, YOUR_ or your-, or equal to xxx, ..., changeme, replace-me or todo (case-insensitive). ${VAR} references are not placeholders; they get a note that each agent resolves them its own way.
rules.rejections: type sse, or a URL ending in /sse with no transport: 'SSE-only servers aren't portable. Use the server's Streamable HTTP address.' URL user:password: 'Put credentials in a header, not in the URL.' More than 64 KiB: 'That's too long to be a server snippet.'

cases.ui: Show 'Found 2 servers' with a choice; fill the form from the chosen one. Add the others afterwards.

cases.input: claude mcp add --transport http docs https://docs.example.test/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"
claude mcp add --env ISSUES_TOKEN="<your token>" issues -- npx -y @acme/issues-mcp

cases.ui: An empty argument or one with a newline opens the command in one-per-line mode.
-e NAME with no value passes the variable through from the environment. Suggest adding GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN as an environment row.

errors: legacy: SSE-only servers aren’t portable. Use the server’s Streamable HTTP address.
Put credentials in a header, not in the URL.
Couldn’t read that as JSON. Check that it’s complete.
